layouts: Nested first 1, 2, or 3 sites. Single first site is midpoint.

reference.scheme: Conservative radial finite-volume, implicit transport, exact local reaction split
reference.inlet: Persistent upstream reservoir; distal backflow Th=0,Fg=1; Fn immobile
reference.junction: Zero-volume perfectly mixed node for three vessels

scoring: Per-case relative L2, reference cell-volume and trapezoidal-time weights; average cases equally

inverse.selection: Per-method validation mean inlet error across all layouts/noise; never test

training.architecture: Original per-topology architecture and respective original losses retained
training.initialization: Fresh random parameters; no old checkpoint initialization
training.selection: Validation only; identical case split and common scoring across topologies
training.single_order: Seeded shuffle; every four optimizer updates cover all 64 training cases
training.throughput_pilot: A full-64-case pilot was stopped after measuring ~1 second/update; no test data inspected; its weights are not used for initialization or selection.

scope: Fixed independent blood flow per topology; new biochemical inlet curves, not unseen-flow generalization

seven.status: active: independent CFD, three-seed training and evaluation required

future_seven: Same inlets, split, generator, observation schedule, noise, optimizer and scoring. Geometry/topology from pinned Sen seven-vessel source. Primary sites preset by topology, not test performance. No seven-vessel training or CFD claim in this run.

c0.physics: Conservative one-dimensional finite volume; molecular diffusion D=2e-4; reaction 2 Th Fg; no memory or learned correction
c0.three: Existing three-vessel C0: implicit transport followed by exact local reaction
c0.calibration: No fitted closure coefficients; only inlet regularization selected on the common validation set
c0.note: Existing per-topology time discretizations retained; common equations and shared 2 ms candidate time grid. Reference uses the common 1 ms resolved solver.

seven_training: Reuse the original three-vessel heads, widths, layers, two-memory transport and physical moment losses; only topology adjacency and numerical operator dimensions change. Same 64/16/32 cases and seeds 42/43/44.
inference_precision: FP64 transport, reaction features and reaction head; same trained weights. Branched graph adjacency is applied sparsely with verified equality to its dense operator.
precision_validation: A pre-test three-vessel FP32 validation diagnostic exhibited projected-gradient stagnation near 1e-7; final three-vessel validation is rerun in FP64 without changing architectures, checkpoints, splits, objectives or stopping rules.
